'''Peter Kopac''' was the tournament director of the [[2003 Slovakia National Championship|Slovakia National Championship]], held on 29 June 2003 at Detsky Kulturny Klub Slniecko.<ref name="pc-intl03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/intlevents.htm Nationals and Provincials (International Events)], swccgpc.com (2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040621085705/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/intlevents.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
